_schema_description: SSCP guidance-backed rule pack v0.3.0 (Phase 6C). 10 rules total. 4 deterministic rules (intended_purpose section, device_description section, basic_udi_di metadata, notified_body identifier) are RA_approved with verbatim excerpts from the locally pinned MDCG 2019-9 Rev.1 source (sha256 0148f179...). The remaining 6 subjective/conditional rules stay RA_pending with source_excerpt_pending=true. No rule produces an ECO finding in v0; Phase 6B's checklist renderer is the only consumer. Excerpts are normalised for two classes of PDF extraction artifacts: (1) double-space runs collapsed to single space, and (2) space-before-punctuation patterns (e.g. 'presented , including' -> 'presented, including') removed. Both classes are extraction layout artifacts, not source semantics. The substantive text of each excerpt is verbatim from MDCG 2019-9 Rev.1.

rules.source_title: MDCG 2019-9 Rev.1 - Summary of safety and clinical performance: A guide for manufacturers and notified bodies
rules.exact_excerpt: The device's intended purpose(s) shall be described.
rules.paraphrase: The SSCP should clearly state the intended purpose of the device, including patient population and intended use environment.
rules.notes: Section-presence check; deterministic candidate via heading match once promoted. Excerpt is from MDCG 2019-9 Rev.1 section 2.1 (page 12). Source-grounded approval gates Phase 6D deterministic checker.

rules.source_title: MDCG 2019-9 Rev.1 - Summary of safety and clinical performance: A guide for manufacturers and notified bodies
rules.exact_excerpt: A description of the device shall be presented, including its operating principles and mode(s) of action.
rules.paraphrase: The SSCP should include a description of the device with variants, components, accessories, and any combination products.
rules.notes: Section-presence check; deterministic candidate via heading match once promoted. Excerpt is from MDCG 2019-9 Rev.1 section 3.1 (page 12). The longer requirement enumerating variants/accessories/combination products is in the section 3 heading and section 3.2-3.4; this excerpt anchors the core presence obligation. PDF extraction artifact: pypdf renders this passage as 'shall be presented , including' with a space before the comma; the excerpt removes the space-before-punctuation per the policy declared in the pack _schema_description.

rules.source_title: MDCG 2019-9 Rev.1 - Summary of safety and clinical performance: A guide for manufacturers and notified bodies
rules.exact_excerpt: The identification of the device and the manufacturer, including the Basic UDI-DI and, if already issued, the SRN
rules.paraphrase: The SSCP should carry the Basic UDI-DI on the identification page (or equivalent metadata block).
rules.notes: Pattern check: Basic UDI-DI string format. Excerpt is from MDCG 2019-9 Rev.1 section 1 heading (page 11), which mirrors MDR Article 32(2)(a). The statutory MDR text is also locally inventoried under eu-mdr-2017-745-art-32 and may be promoted as the canonical source in a future packet.

rules.source_title: MDCG 2019-9 Rev.1 - Summary of safety and clinical performance: A guide for manufacturers and notified bodies
rules.exact_excerpt: NB’s name (the NB that will validate the SSCP) and the NB’s single identification number
rules.paraphrase: The SSCP should identify the notified body involved in the conformity assessment, including its four-digit identifier.
rules.notes: Pattern check: four-digit NB number near identification block. Excerpt is from MDCG 2019-9 Rev.1 section 1.9 (page 11). The MDCG document uses 'single identification number' rather than 'four-digit identifier' explicitly; the paraphrase reflects the common operational form (NB numbers are four digits) but the rule's source-backed obligation is the broader 'single identification number'.

rules.source_title: MDCG 2019-9 Rev.1 - Summary of safety and clinical performance: A guide for manufacturers and notified bodies
rules.paraphrase: The SSCP should be aligned with the CER (and with PMS/PMCF outputs); a human reviewer confirms that quantitative claims and benefit-risk language reference the CER and remain consistent with it.
rules.notes: Semantic alignment; not deterministically checkable in V1. Today: checklist prompt to the reviewer. Phase 6D may upgrade the underlying source to MDR Article 61 (clinical evaluation) plus MDCG language about TD alignment.

rules.source_title: MDCG 2019-9 Rev.1 - Summary of safety and clinical performance: A guide for manufacturers and notified bodies
rules.paraphrase: The SSCP should be written in objective, non-promotional language suitable for the intended audience.
rules.notes: Subjective. If an AI-assisted observation is added later, V-R8 ensures it cannot be promoted to an ECO finding without human confirmation. Excerpt approval deferred until RA reviewer authors a verbatim excerpt from the MDCG general-requirements section.

rules.source_title: MDCG 2019-9 Rev.1 - Summary of safety and clinical performance: A guide for manufacturers and notified bodies
rules.paraphrase: When the device is intended for patient use or partial patient exposure, the SSCP should include a section specifically targeted at patients in addition to the section for healthcare professionals.
rules.notes: Conditional on device class and use scenario; reviewer judges whether the patient section is warranted and adequate.

rules.source_title: MDCG 2019-9 Rev.1 - Summary of safety and clinical performance: A guide for manufacturers and notified bodies
rules.paraphrase: Quantitative risk figures presented in the SSCP should carry a time basis (e.g. per implantation year) and reference the CER or PMS data they were drawn from.
rules.notes: Reviewer reads the risk section and confirms each number has explicit time basis and a source pointer.

rules.source_title: MDCG 2019-9 Rev.1 - Summary of safety and clinical performance: A guide for manufacturers and notified bodies
rules.paraphrase: Where the device has been subject to a field safety corrective action or field safety notice during the SSCP reporting period, the SSCP should disclose this in a clear, dated entry.
rules.notes: Conditional. Reviewer confirms whether an FSCA/FSN occurred and whether its disclosure is present.

rules.source_title: MDCG 2019-9 Rev.1 - Summary of safety and clinical performance: A guide for manufacturers and notified bodies
rules.paraphrase: The SSCP should describe the planned or ongoing PMCF activities (study type, key endpoints, time frame) or, where PMCF is not applicable, the SSCP should justify this and cite the PMCF justification document.
rules.notes: Reviewer confirms a PMCF section is present or that absence is justified with a documented reference.
